uncited: **CPU: Compute Silhouettes.** Compute the silhouettes of every moving shadow caster.
**GPU: Base Rendering.** Render the scene using conventional polygonal rendering to obtain direct illumination and indirect single scattering.
Use shadow plane algorithms for surface shadows.
The stencil buffer now contains lit areas of the scene.
**GPU: Single Scattering Pass.** Render the scene once more.
Compute direct single scattering for each vertex.
**GPU: Shadow Volume Rendering.** Render shadow planes in the sorted order.
Depth test accepts only planes closer to the camera.
Front-facing planes add contribution and decrement the stencil buffer.
Back-facing planes subtract contribution and increment the stencil buffer.
